name: Wedding & event planner

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Nadia and Elena (planners at the studio)

services.name: Full planning
services.story: The main story: full planning for Alex and Robin's wedding, quoted at $8,500 after Nadia's free first call (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Both sign the contract, and a $2,550 retainer holds the date. The $5,950 rest is billed in stages, each one when Nadia texts DONE for it (two stages of $2,975 in the example); Rosie never bills on a date by itself.

services.name: Planning consult (1 hour)
services.story: A $150 planning consult (1 hour) for a couple who plans it themselves, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Extra planning meeting (1 hour)
services.story: An extra planning meeting (1 hour) after the contract's 10 are used: $150, nothing taken to book, and Rosie texts the bill after.

services.name: Free first call (45 min)
services.story: The free first call (45 minutes) with the planner who would lead the wedding: nothing taken, nothing after.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Julian and Gabe (planners on the day)

services.name: Month-of coordination
services.story: The main story: month-of coordination for Alex and Robin's wedding at Cedar Hill Farm, Thu Oct 22, quoted at $2,400 after Julian's free first call (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Both partners and Sam sign the contract, a $600 retainer holds the date, and the $1,800 rest is charged to the saved card when Julian texts DONE after the day. An extra hour on the night is priced first and needs a yes.

questions_before_times: What it is: a wedding, an engagement party, a corporate event or another party
The date, or a season if there's no date yet
The area, and the venue's name and town if there is one (for travel)
Which service: full planning, partial planning, month-of coordination, a consult, or not sure
safety_stop: Someone hurt, a fire, or danger at the venue right now
license: No state license for planning or coordinating weddings and events in most places. A local business license where the city or county asks for one: from the state form.
staff_skills: ["Full planning (leads only)","Month-of coordination","Planning consults","Corporate events","Design and rentals"]
messages_never: The budget, the guest list, family details, access or health needs and gate codes stay on the secure page. Texts to the owner, the planners or the couple carry none of them: only names, dates, times, places and the planner's fee.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
